brief_rationale: All eight responsibility-chain items were met with source-verified citations. Four high-order points (HO1-HO4) were triggered and completed with distinct evidence beyond minimum duties. Closure was safe, executable, and traceable with caregiver teach-back. No in-chain errors or important non-chain defects were present. Multiple high-order points completed with meaningful trajectory impact qualifies for Perfect.

closure_assessment.explanation: The trajectory concluded with clear, actionable instructions: red-flag monitoring criteria, medication continuation, ongoing test result review, and specialist follow-up. Caregiver demonstrated teach-back confirming understanding. Residual uncertainties (exact follow-up date, prednisone end date) are explicitly permitted by the closure contract.
